I've grown a little exhausted of running in circles trying to get a 6% drop, only to get the 30th or 40th copy of the same weapon component that I don't want and literally can neither use nor sell. The punchline is that I'd probably spend a bit of money on cosmetics if I could reasonably obtain Descendants through normal gameplay, but I refuse to keep doing the same thing for hours while making zero progress towards any meaningful objectives.

I'll be back if the RNG drop-based system moves in the direction of being more consistent and measurable, but for now my recommendation is to stay away.

It's a free DL, with cherry picked similarities to lots of games you've played where they took some of the better elements from those games which I can't always think of (like right now as I write the review) and made it into a reasonably fun money mill. Destiny comes to mind and the first time you hit the first map it'll take you straight back to the first time you played both D1 and D2.  I've never played Warframe, but friends who have bring it up.  There are others as well.

The cosmetic purchases are a bit steep, in my opinion, though some are tempting as it is graphically well done with highly attractive characters - definitely not "woke," which is a good thing. Decorations to go on your backpack strap or emotes can run $5-10 individually. These are NOT required to play.  You could probably get all of the character packs *without* cosmetics for less than the price of most modern AAA games, that said.

Other than that it is a bit grindy, and, while I know my luck is awful, I've found the grind to consistently be beyond the listed drop rate.  I haven't even bothered to try any of the 1% drops.

The game play is fun, with a level of speed an agility that most modern shooter developers seem to forget about, yet, which all reflex players know make or break a game and the cumbersome feel is the ruin of many a modern game (in my opinion, but I know I'm not alone.)  The game is more fluid and fast than cumbersome, especially if you play Bunny - who is genuinely awesome for more reasons than tits and ass.  Which she definitely has.  Ah..... another influence.  She's almost like if baby DVa (Korean girl with a Bunny theme) was given Tracer's speed coupled with an electric field that's more powerful the faster you go.  Which is the point to her existence - speed.  So, yeah... she is as good as she sounds.  She also has tits and ass, if that's what you're in it for and, chances are, if you've seen any video at all, you have seen the ultimate Bunny skin.... but there really is a reason beyond that.  "Looks" wise, if this is what we were judging it on, Freyna or Luna would be more my personal thing, but I don't care for Freyna's kit so much.  It is there, if you just want the wank bait... and i'm sure the ladies will find a gentleman to make them say "daddy" if that is what they want (and, obviously, there is a bit of a hetero bias.)  It is there, there is no denying it, but so is the gameplay and kits.

So, you can grind most things you would other wise pay for, but you can also get stuck in the grind,  which kinda got me out of it, aside from the fact that I've been playing other things.  It's meh.

The game play is very good, fast, furious, and fun..... but as you advance, you come out of certain maps to go to a boss and literally no one you play with is prepared (hopefully at this point more people are just grinding pieces and parts), but I let myself get distracted about the second or third time I went into a boss fight, realized I needed to go back and grind my weapons (much like Destiny, you can use a high level weapon you don't want to advance the level of a weapon you want to use, though, it does require pieces and parts and time consuming "research." So, even if what you like isn't what is available in the highest level zones, you can still get a better version of what you do like...)

The story isn't really bad, but it does take a backseat to getting you from action to action, for BOTH good and ill.

So... yeah.. it is fun and you don't have to spend money, but you can if you want.  That stuff can be crazy or surprisingly reasonable compared to other stuff.  I mean, I think you can get one of the character packs for the price of a couple cosmetic items that do nothing but adorn your backpack strap (I think the most basic character pack is 750 of the in game paid currency and backpack strap items and emotes are 400-500.)  Seriously?

I feel I can write this after 100+ hours (I only play this 2-3 days a week. Fight me) This is the game in a nutshell: Warframe with ass. It's not as good as current Warframe but its about as good as Warframe was before it got better. If the devs continue their QOL updates for us and still be creative over time, this game will evolve into something nice. But be warned: this game is not for everyone. Here's why:

1) This game is a braindead grind fest for the items and characters you want. OR you can pay money for an ultimate character. You pick. Whats the benefits of braindead grind fest? Its braindead fun if you're know how to play properly. 

2) The monetization. I'm not discouraged by it. Others will be. IT's a free to play game and you buy things for a lump sum. Orr you go back to your favorite gacha game and waste more money on a 50/50 you'll lose than on this game. You pick. 

3) Some icks of discouragement. Enemies are aimbotty. Not enough info in game for newbies to learn how to kill the bosses. No proper pity system in place yet for hours of grinding and getting nothing. And as of this moment, we'll have to wait a while for a vendor to take care of replica items (once you get a descendant, you don't need their materials anymore) All of these are easily fixed with ongoing QOL fixes. 

Why you should grab this game (and support it money wise): Turn on some music or your favorite podcast for a few hours, have a grind plan in mind, and watch your favorite piece of ass run around slaughtering everything in sight with a giggle in background (looking at you bunny mains) Its also a unreal 5 game that works decently so there's that. 

Why you shouldn't grab this game: You don't like grindy free to play games and you're afraid of your wife (or husband) beating your ass with all the ass on the screen.

I give this game a solid 8/10 for funzies and booty and will bump it to a 9 when more QOL updates happen. I'll give it a 10 if Nexon keeps putting in more mechanics that piss off the reddit community. It's funny when they start crying about it.

First off, chose wisely on what your first hero is. You're stuck with it.

Now, this game is aggressively bland. The basic gameplay loop feels like a chore. The dialogue is pure garbage and means nothing of consequence. The visuals make my eyes tired from how generic they are. They could fit in any number of generic live service games. At least the waifus look good, however. 

I'm not giving you money or grinding to get past the first hero + the taster second hero. That's how these games all operate. They give you 1 you don't want for free and then  make the second okish one easy to get. That way they can hook you into giving them twenty dollars, or wasting more time than its worth acquiring a new one. 

Also the game runs like trash. I can do cyberpunk 2077, red dead redemption 2, or arma 3 with nearly max graphics but this game and its tiny world cells make my system chug at medium graphics. Then there's the level loads where the loading bar loads backwards for a minute. Why do you need level loads for such small maps? Indie titles with shoestring budgets these days can swing large worlds without a level load every 500 yards. 

11/10 would uninstall again.
